market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 30-year yield spike, oil above $103, and industrial technical breakdown. However, resilient labor market (197K claims), US-China truce, and AI momentum provide support. Expect elevated volatility with potential yield inflection per BCA. Nasdaq may pull back from all-time highs as yield sensitivity bites. 2-3 week window for yield peak test.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact but leverage risk (SoftBank model) warrants caution. Energy transition in Africa (Dangote) and defense spending provide multi-year themes. Housing market under structural pressure from elevated rates. US-China relationship in 'uneasy equilibrium' per India's assessment, suggesting persistent trade friction. Bond market normalization could unlock equity re-rating if yields stabilize.
